resync-on-switch.description: Auto-resync window geometry when switching back to a dedicated workspace
resync-on-switch.tooltip: Fixes X11 fractional scaling offset or clipping when returning to a dedicated workspace.

settle-delay.tooltip: Delay after switching workspaces before resizing the window. Use 0 ms on 100% display scale; 100-250 ms works well on fractional scaling (e.g. 125%).

restore-maximize-delay.tooltip: Delay between resetting the window frame and re-maximizing when returning a previously maximized window to its original workspace.

exit-hotkey.tooltip: Sends the focused window to a dedicated workspace, or returns it to its original workspace if already in one.
